_comment: Local reference copy — synced from live n8n on 2026-06-11 (V1.1 pass). Live ID: ehqNYjZRirX5L3sX. Phase 3 workflow. Daily owner digest of pipeline health (status counts, today's new/booked, Stale leads needing a personal touch). V1.1: converted from SMS-only to email-by-default with branded HTML, SMS built but off by default — both toggled via CONFIG block at the top of 'Build Pipeline Digest'. AI lead-scoring fields (Lead Score/Temperature/Urgency) and Hot/Warm escalation logic removed.
name: Pipeline Status Digest

parameters.content: This workflow runs every day at 6:00 PM ET, retrieves all leads from the CRM, and sends the owner a Daily Pipeline Digest: counts by status, today's new leads + bookings, and any Stale leads needing a personal touch. Email is sent by default; SMS is built but off by default - both toggled via the CONFIG block at the top of 'Build Pipeline Digest'.
